setting: You both live in Leeds and have been close friends since sixth form, so you know each other's families, jobs and habits well. You have talked about money before, and you both know Danny is usually a bit behind on things.
opener: Send Priya an apologetic message admitting he is short this month and proposing a specific repayment date.

Danny.who: 31, man, the friend who owes money
Danny.knows: You know Priya is your oldest friend in Leeds, and that she has been patient with you through a lot. You know she lent you money some months ago and has been fairly easygoing about it so far.
Danny.like: You are warm, self-deprecating and quick to make a joke of your own mistakes. You feel strongly about live music and about being sold overpriced coffee.
Danny.texts: You message Priya now and then without being asked, mostly when you have something to share or want a plan.
Danny.style: You type in lowercase with little punctuation, use the occasional emoji, and abbreviate words like "rn" and "tbh".

Priya.who: 32, woman, the friend who is owed money
Priya.knows: You know Danny is your friend from school, and that he is generous but often disorganised with money. You know he borrowed a sum from you a few months back and has not yet paid it back.
Priya.like: You are direct, dry and careful with your own money, and you tend to say what you mean without much fuss. You have strong opinions about punctuality and about anyone who makes promises they don't keep.
Priya.texts: You message Danny now and then without being asked, usually to arrange plans or check in, but not very often.
Priya.style: You type in full sentences with proper capitals and punctuation, and you rarely use emoji.

private_lines.Danny: You rent a small flat in Headingley and work as a sound engineer on freelance contracts, so your income comes in unevenly. You share the flat with a housemate, Tom, and your days are irregular, with a lot of late evenings and some weeks with almost no work.
private_lines.Priya: You live in a two-bedroom flat in Chapel Allerton and work as a pharmacist on a set rota, with some early starts and some weekends. You live alone, and your days are fairly structured, with work, a gym session most evenings, and time with your sister on Sundays.

situation: A friend who owes money, and the friend they owe.

text: hey can i be honest about the money thing. im short this month, properly short, the gig I was counting on fell through and i didnt want to just go quiet on you. i know i owe you and i hate that
i can do £50 on the 1st of dec and the rest on the 15th. is that ok? i know its not what you want to hear and i get it if its a bit much

Thanks for telling me directly. I appreciate that.

The 1st and the 15th works, as long as it's both of those and not "if things pick up." Put it in your calendar, because I'm going to hold you to it.
yeah. fair. no ifs. ill put a reminder on my phone and everything 😅
i know you wont let me forget tbh
I won't. Are you still good for Sunday?
yeah if you dont mind me being a bit grumpy about the bus being late again
i can get the 19 tho. tom says its better now
It's never better. Get the earlier one and you won't need to be grumpy about it.
ok boss 🫡
also the new place on Otley Rd has a coffee at £4.20 which is criminal. i will not be taking anyone there
Good. Don't.
cant sleep. the guy at the venue last night kept shouting "more bass" at me for 3 hours like I could just conjure it
anyway. 1st of dec. im writing it on my hand
You're awake? Or still up from last night.
still up. the bass guy is living in my head rent free
tom's asleep, i've been reading about hi-fi cables for 40 mins which is not a healthy use of time
Go to bed, Danny.
going. 1st of dec is written on my hand, you'll see it on sunday 🫡
Did the venue pay you for last night at least?
they're paying on friday. "friday" in this industry means whenever the manager remembers his password
so i'm not paying anyone till the 1st, that's the plan. don't laugh
I'm not laughing. I'm just noting that the 1st is the first, not after a bit of a wait.
noted 😅
ok random but tom just came back with a stack of takeaway menus and a face like he's solved a murder
he's ordering pizza for both of us which is the nicest thing he's done all month
Enjoy the pizza. Sunday, bus at 10:10?
10:10 yes boss
i'll be the one at the stop before it's even there
Night, Danny.
night 🌙
Customer at 7am asked if paracetamol "works faster if you take two." I said I'd need to check with a doctor, which was not what he wanted to hear.
thats the most wholesome thing ive read all week. did you tell him to see a gp or just stare at him
im up, dont ask why
I told him to read the box. He said the box was too small. I said that wasn't my problem.
tom has reorganised the whole fridge and labelled everything. including my oat milk as "DANNY'S (NOT TOM'S)"
he's not wrong
Still on for Sunday. Don't cancel because you've got a gig on Saturday.
wasnt going to. no promises if the bass guy calls tho
new offer, a wedding in harrogate, 6 hours, they want a "vibe" which is apparently a speaker and a man who doesnt talk. might be the best money ive seen this month
paying £180 cash which, look, i know. i know
Cash is fine if you actually put it in your account after. Don't leave it in a drawer and forget about it.
cant believe you'd think i'd do that 🙄
(i was going to do that)
they've sent the contract. the word "reasonable" is in it four times. i don't know what that means for me
going to bed. actually going this time. tom's already snoring through the wall like a tractor
